action: Used an atomic bomb against Hiroshima
mechanism: Single nuclear airburst with city-scale blast, thermal, and radiation effects
claimed_objective: Compel Japanese surrender and shorten the war
outcomes: Destruction of military and civilian infrastructure
Japanese surrender followed within the broader sequence of August 1945 events

answers.reason: The intervention imposed rather than voluntarily absorbed civilian cost.
Survivor autonomy and physical capability were severely damaged.
Stated intention was converted into decisive observable action.
War-ending purpose is disputed against demonstration and targeting purposes.
Created durable state capacity but primarily destructive capacity.
Initiated a self-reinforcing nuclear arms structure.
Civilian population was not a bounded set of military decision-makers.
Key planning and alternatives were not publicly inspectable at decision time.

wrapper.note: Claimed defensive and war-ending orientation is materially disputed; hidden motive is not inferred.
